EOS: IAPWS R16-17(2018); pure D2O density surrogate at fixed benchmark isotope ratios
structural_temperatures: Held at Tc0 for sheath, pressure tube and helium; Tm0 for calandria
inventories: Existing shared benchmark histories; not independently validated operating depletion
seeds: Distinct odd seeds for every state
pressure_column_interpretation: Reference pressures define base densities. Fixed-density temperature perturbations do not assert constant pressure; only density_mode=pressure follows the EOS constant-pressure path.

dragon_solver_controls.acceptance: Explicit external convergence required; no CONVERGENCE NOT REACHED messages
dragon_solver_controls.basis: Controls checked against three-state fresh solver pilot, with separate tighter-control sensitivity pilot

provisional_dragon_listings_excluded: OP_LOCAL_J2 and OP_CONV_PILOT; infeasible tighter flux tolerances
